info.description:
### Welcome to Postman! This is your first collection. 

Collections are your starting point for building and testing APIs. You can use this one to:

• Group related requests
• Test your API in real-world scenarios
• Document and share your requests

Update the name and overview whenever you’re ready to make it yours.

[Learn more about Postman Collections.](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collections/collections-overview/)

request.description:
Registers a new user account in the **RentNest** platform.

Send a `POST` request to `/api/auth/register` with the user's details in the JSON body. On success, the server creates the account, assigns the specified role, and returns the newly created user object with a `201 Created` status.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Full name of the user |
| `email` | string | Yes | User's email address |
| `password` | string | Yes | Account password |
| `role` | string | Yes | Role assigned to the user — `TENANT` or `LANDLORD` |

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

Returns a JSON object with the following structure:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | `true` on successful registration |
| `statusCode` | number | HTTP status code (`201`) |
| `message` | string | Confirmation message |
| `data.id` | string (UUID) | Unique identifier of the created user |
| `data.name` | string | Registered name |
| `data.email` | string | Registered email |
| `data.role` | string | Assigned role (e.g. `TENANT`) |
| `data.activeStatus` | string | Account status — defaults to `ACTIVE` upon registration |
| `data.createdAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp of account creation |

---

### Notes

- A newly registered user's `activeStatus` is automatically set to `ACTIVE`.
- The `role` field determines the user's permissions within the platform (`TENANT` for renters, `LANDLORD` for property owners).
- The `email` must be unique; attempting to register with a duplicate email will result in an error.

Authenticates an existing user and returns an access token for subsequent authorized requests.

Send a `POST` request to `/api/auth/login` with the user's credentials in the JSON body. On success, the server validates the credentials and returns a JWT or session token along with the user's profile details.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `email` | string | Yes | The registered email address of the user |
| `password` | string | Yes | The user's account password |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns a JSON object containing the authentication token and user information.

---

### Notes

- The token returned must be included in the `Authorization` header (as a Bearer token) for all protected endpoints.
- Invalid credentials will result in a `401 Unauthorized` error.

Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/auth/me` with a valid Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. The server identifies the user from the token and returns their profile data.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns the authenticated user's profile object, including fields such as `id`, `name`, `email`, `role`, `activeStatus`, and `createdAt`.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication. Requests without a valid token will receive a `401 Unauthorized` response.
- Useful for verifying the current session and retrieving user context on the client side.

Allows an authenticated user to change their account password.

Send a `PATCH` request to `/api/user/change-password` with the current and new passwords in the JSON body. The server verifies the current password before applying the update.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `currentPassword` | string | Yes | The user's existing password |
| `newPassword` | string | Yes | The new password to set |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns a confirmation message indicating the password was updated successfully.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication via a Bearer token.
- The current password must match the stored password; otherwise a `400` or `401` error is returned.

Updates the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

Send a `PATCH` request to `/api/user/update` with the fields to be updated in the JSON body. Only the provided fields will be modified; omitted fields remain unchanged.

---

### Request Body (partial update)

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Updated full name of the user |
| `email` | string | Updated email address |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns the updated user profile object.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication via a Bearer token.
- Only the fields included in the request body will be updated.

Retrieves all properties listed by the currently authenticated landlord.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/landlord/properties` with a valid Bearer token. The server identifies the landlord from the token and returns only their own property listings.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns an array of property objects belonging to the authenticated landlord.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to users with the `LANDLORD` role.
- Returns an empty array if the landlord has not listed any properties yet.

Creates a new rental property listing for the authenticated landlord.

Send a `POST` request to `/api/landlord/properties` with the property details in the JSON body. On success, the server creates the listing and returns the newly created property object.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | string | Yes | Title or name of the property |
| `description` | string | Yes | Detailed description of the property |
| `location` | string | Yes | Address or area of the property |
| `rent` | number | Yes | Monthly rent amount |
| `bedrooms` | number | Yes | Number of bedrooms |

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

Returns the newly created property object including its generated `id` and `createdAt` timestamp.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to users with the `LANDLORD` role.

Updates an existing property listing owned by the authenticated landlord.

Send a `PUT` request to `/api/landlord/properties/:id`, replacing `:id` with the UUID of the property to update. Include the fields to be updated in the JSON body.

---

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string (UUID) | The unique identifier of the property to update |

---

### Request Body (partial or full update)

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `title` | string | Updated title of the property |
| `description` | string | Updated description |
| `location` | string | Updated location |
| `rent` | number | Updated monthly rent |
| `bedrooms` | number | Updated bedroom count |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns the updated property object.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to the `LANDLORD` role.
- Only the landlord who owns the property can update it.

Deletes a property listing owned by the authenticated landlord.

Send a `DELETE` request to `/api/landlord/properties/:id`, replacing `:id` with the UUID of the property to remove. On success, the property is permanently deleted from the platform.

---

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string (UUID) | The unique identifier of the property to delete |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns a confirmation message indicating the property was deleted successfully.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to the `LANDLORD` role.
- Only the landlord who owns the property can delete it.
- This action is irreversible.

Retrieves a list of all publicly available rental properties on the RentNest platform.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/properties`. No authentication is required. This endpoint is intended for tenants and visitors browsing available listings.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns an array of property objects, each containing details such as property ID, title, location, rent, and availability status.

---

### Notes

- This is a public endpoint — no Bearer token is needed.
- Supports optional query parameters for filtering and pagination (e.g. `page`, `limit`, `location`).

Retrieves the full details of a single rental property by its unique ID.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/properties/:id`, replacing `:id` with the UUID of the target property. No authentication is required.

---

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string (UUID) | The unique identifier of the property |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns a single property object with all available details including title, description, location, rent, images, and landlord information.

---

### Notes

- This is a public endpoint — no Bearer token is needed.
- Returns `404 Not Found` if no property exists with the given ID.

Retrieves a list of all registered users on the platform. This is an admin-only endpoint.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/admin/users` with a valid Bearer token belonging to an admin user.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns an array of user objects, each containing `id`, `name`, `email`, `role`, `activeStatus`, and `createdAt`.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to users with the `ADMIN` role.
- Useful for user management and platform administration.

Allows an admin to update the active status of a user account (e.g. activate or deactivate it).

Send a request to `/api/admin/users/:id/status`, replacing `:id` with the UUID of the target user. Include the new status in the request body.

---

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string (UUID) | The unique identifier of the user |

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `activeStatus` | string | Yes | The new status — e.g. `ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE` |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns the updated user object with the new `activeStatus` applied.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to users with the `ADMIN` role.
- Deactivating a user prevents them from logging in or accessing protected endpoints.

Retrieves all property listings across the platform. This is an admin-only endpoint.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/admin/properties` with a valid Bearer token belonging to an admin user.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns an array of all property objects on the platform, including their details and associated landlord information.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to users with the `ADMIN` role.
- Useful for platform-wide property management and moderation.

Retrieves all rental requests across the entire platform. This is an admin-only endpoint.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/admin/rental-requests` with a valid Bearer token belonging to an admin user. Returns a complete list of all rental requests regardless of tenant or landlord.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns an array of all rental request objects on the platform, each including tenant details, property details, status, and timestamps.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to users with the `ADMIN` role.
- Useful for platform-wide oversight and moderation.

Submits a rental request from a tenant for a specific property.

Send a `POST` request to `/api/rentals` with the rental details in the JSON body. The server creates a new rental request associated with the authenticated tenant and the specified property.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `propertyId` | string (UUID) | Yes | The ID of the property the tenant wants to rent |
| `moveInDate` | string (ISO 8601) | Yes | The desired move-in date |
| `message` | string | No | An optional message to the landlord |

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

Returns the newly created rental request object including its `id`, `status`, and associated property and tenant details.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to users with the `TENANT` role.
- The initial status of a rental request is typically `PENDING`.

Retrieves all rental requests submitted by the currently authenticated tenant.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/rentals` with a valid Bearer token. The server identifies the tenant from the token and returns all their rental requests along with the associated property details.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns an array of rental request objects belonging to the authenticated tenant, each including the request `id`, `status`, `moveInDate`, `message`, and linked property information.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is intended for users with the `TENANT` role.
- Returns an empty array if the tenant has not submitted any rental requests.

Retrieves the full details of a single rental request by its unique ID.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/rentals/:id`, replacing `:id` with the UUID of the target rental request.

---

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string (UUID) | The unique identifier of the rental request |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns a single rental request object with all details including `status`, `moveInDate`, `message`, tenant info, and property info.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication.
- Returns `404 Not Found` if no rental request exists with the given ID.

Retrieves all rental requests submitted for properties owned by the authenticated landlord.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/landlord/requests` with a valid Bearer token. The server returns all incoming rental requests across all of the landlord's listed properties.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns an array of rental request objects, each including the request `id`, `status`, tenant details, `moveInDate`, and the associated property.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to users with the `LANDLORD` role.
    
- Returns an empty array if no rental requests have been submitted for the landlord's properties.

Allows a landlord to update the status of a rental request (e.g. approve or reject it).

Send a `PATCH` request to `/api/landlord/requests/:id`, replacing `:id` with the UUID of the rental request. Include the new status in the JSON body.

---

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string (UUID) | The unique identifier of the rental request to update |

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `status` | string | Yes | The new status — e.g. `APPROVED` or `REJECTED` |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns the updated rental request object with the new status applied.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication and is restricted to the `LANDLORD` role.
- Only the landlord who owns the associated property can update the request status.

Submits a review for a completed rental experience.

Send a `POST` request to `/api/reviews` with the review details in the JSON body. The review is linked to a specific rental request, allowing tenants to rate and comment on their experience.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `rentalRequestId` | string (UUID) | Yes | The ID of the completed rental request being reviewed |
| `rating` | number | Yes | A numeric rating (e.g. 1–5) |
| `comment` | string | No | An optional written comment about the experience |

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

Returns the newly created review object including its `id`, `rating`, `comment`, and associated rental request details.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication.
- A review can only be submitted for a rental request that has been completed or approved.

Initiates a payment for an approved rental request.

Send a `POST` request to `/api/payments/create` with the rental request ID in the JSON body. The server creates a payment record and returns the payment details or a redirect URL for completing the transaction.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `rentalRequestId` | string (UUID) | Yes | The ID of the approved rental request to pay for |

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

Returns the created payment object or a payment gateway URL to complete the transaction.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication.
- Payment can only be initiated for rental requests with an `APPROVED` status.

Confirms and finalizes a payment after it has been processed by the payment gateway.

Send a `POST` request to `/api/payments/confirm` with the payment reference or transaction details. The server verifies the payment and marks it as confirmed.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `paymentId` | string | Yes | The ID or reference of the payment to confirm |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns the confirmed payment object with an updated status (e.g. `CONFIRMED` or `PAID`).

---

### Notes

- This endpoint is typically called after a successful redirect from the payment gateway.
- Returns an error if the payment reference is invalid or already confirmed.

Retrieves all payment records associated with the currently authenticated user.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/payments` with a valid Bearer token. The server returns all payments linked to the authenticated user's rental requests.

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns an array of payment objects, each including the payment `id`, `amount`, `status`, `createdAt`, and associated rental request details.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication.
- Returns an empty array if the user has no payment records.

Retrieves the full details of a single payment record by its unique ID.

Send a `GET` request to `/api/payments/:id`, replacing `:id` with the UUID of the target payment.

---

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string (UUID) | The unique identifier of the payment |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

Returns a single payment object with all details including `amount`, `status`, `createdAt`, and the associated rental request.

---

### Notes

- This endpoint requires authentication.
- Returns `404 Not Found` if no payment exists with the given ID.
